title: e2e: studio-customize-journey intermittently loses a meta read to ECONNRESET in Live E2E UI and kicks PRs out of the merge queue
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC

Filing gate: ② a CI instrument defect with a named location, seen twice on 2026-11-05 on PRs whose diffs touch no meta-view, Studio or marketplace path. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Business reason: when this spec flakes in the merge queue, the queue removes a green PR and rebuilds every PR queued behind it, which costs a full queue round each time.

## What happens

`ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts:121` ("a read-only base is customized, restored and extended through Studio, and its uninstall is refused") fails in step "Customize a view" with:

```
Error: apiRequestContext.get: read ECONNRESET
  → GET http://localhost:4010/api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress
  at servedColumns (ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts:61)
```

The other 16 live specs pass, including the 6 that run after it, so the server process stays up. The connection is reset rather than the request answered.

| When | Where | Diff under test |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-05 ≈06:50Z | PR #30341 CI run 41981408406 | engine.ts docblocks |
| 2026-11-05 13:46Z | merge-group run 42037558126, job 127279783258 (PR #30463 kicked) | engine docblocks / codemod |

The same spec is green on both PRs' own heads.

## Ask

Find why that GET is reset mid-journey. Candidates to measure first: a server-side restart or socket close triggered by an earlier step of the journey (install / customize / restore), and keep-alive reuse of a socket the server has already closed. Fix the cause; ⛔ do not add a retry or skip that hides a real reset.

Reader who acts: owner of `ui/e2e/live/**` and the live e2e harness in CI (`Live E2E UI` job).

Dedupe: `studio-customize-journey`, `ECONNRESET live e2e`. **New.**
